events.title: Night
events.summary: The regular day/night cycle. Night unlocks the Lunar Minigame and spawns automatic Starflowers.
events.trigger: Automatic. Day lasts 600s, then a night starts (or a Hollow Moon, see below).
facts: The Lunar Altar only accepts a Lunar Ticket during a regular Night. It cannot be started during a Hollow Moon.

While it is night, an automatic Starflower spawns on a random field every 160 seconds (only if no automatic one is already up). It lasts 240 seconds. Players with a Starflower Compass equipped are notified of its rarity and field.

events.title: Hollow Moon
events.summary: A rare red-moon night with a boss arena, roaming Gourd Spiders and Hollow Moon Candy.
events.trigger: When a day ends there is a 1 in 5 (20%) chance that a Hollow Moon starts instead of a normal night. It can also be started globally by the developers.
facts: The sky turns red and the moon changes. Night platforms appear.
The Pumkin Arena hatch opens for the whole event (see PumKinn).
A few seconds after it starts, 3 to 4 random fields get 1 to 3 Gourd Spiders each.
Hollow Moon Candy can drop from gathering and from mob kills only during this event.

events.title: Gourd Spider
events.summary: Hostile mob that appears during the Hollow Moon.
events.trigger: Spawned by the Hollow Moon (see above).
events.duration: Despawns when the Hollow Moon ends.
facts: Starter fields (Blackberry, Mushroom, Dandelion, Blue Flower, Clover): 1,800 HP, level 6, 50 Candy Treats over 2 tokens, 2 to 4 loot rolls.
Every other field: 5,000 HP, level 12, 100 Candy Treats over 4 tokens, 5 to 8 loot rolls.
It leaves burning fire trails and charges at you.

events.title: PumKinn and the Pumkin Arena
events.summary: A solo boss fight in the bunker arena, open for the entire Hollow Moon.
events.trigger: The arena hatch opens when a Hollow Moon starts and closes when it ends. Every player gets their own PumKinn.
facts: 200,000 HP, level 20. It heals back to full if you stay out of the arena for 20 seconds. Touching it deals 15 damage and knocks you back.
Reward: 40 to 50 loot rolls, 1 guaranteed Pumpking Soul.

events.title: Pumpkins (Harvest and Dreadnought)
events.summary: Ability pumpkins that grow while you gather near them, then explode into special field tiles.
events.trigger: Created by the Pumpkin Harvest ability (3 small pumpkins within 20 studs, spaced 9 apart) and the Dreadnought Pumpkin ability (1 pumpkin on the nearest flower).

tables.title: Pumpkin kinds
head: Harvest
Dreadnought
rows: At least 65% of the field's flowers x growth

facts: Only your own gathering within the radius grows the pumpkin.
When it pops, the nearest flowers get pumpkin tiles that last 20 seconds.

events.title: Tanuki's Fortune
events.summary: A fortune boost that turns harvesting into extra honey, pollen and tokens.
events.trigger: Active while you have the Tanuki's Fortune boost.
events.duration: As long as the boost lasts.
facts: Every harvest gives a bonus worth 25% of the harvest value as Honey, Instant conversion or Pollen (one of the three at random).
Collecting white tokens grants 2% of your capacity the same way.
On harvest: 10% chance to drop a Lucky Token (x3 value), otherwise 15% chance to drop a Fortune Charm (1.5s cooldown between drops).
A Fortune Zone (radius 20) spawns a Fortune Charm every 1.5 seconds, 40% of them near Bobsi flowers or Kitsune tokens.

events.title: Blaze
events.trigger: Passive effects from Sunny Bee and fire gear.
facts: Sun Beams (Sunny Bee): 2 beams plus 1 per 5 levels hit random flowers after a 1.5 second warning, gathering 3x3 flowers at x30 and setting them on fire for 6 seconds. Standing in a beam gives Burned (100 stacks that decay over 8 seconds).
Primordial Fire (backpack): 10 second effect, 120 second cooldown.
